name: fracture-id
description: Select contacts, subcontacts, faces and gridpoints with the given DFN fracture ID (the fracture used to create the object). The interval is inclusive; iu defaults to il. The manual also lists zones and blocks (selected if one of their faces matches), but on 3DEC 9.8.54 no zone was selected.
notes: Live 3DEC 9.8.54 (same two-fracture model as dfn-3dec): fracture-id 1 selected the 2 face-face contacts on fracture 1 (identical to dfn-3dec 'd1'), their subcontacts, the 16 zone faces lying on the fracture plane and the 13 gridpoints on it; fracture-id 2 the 4 contacts of the second cut; 'fracture-id 1 2' all 6 contacts. 'block zone group ... range fracture-id 1' assigned no zones (0/47).
The ID is the DFN fracture id ('fracture list'), not the joint id 'block cut dfn' prints (fracture 1 became joint id 2 here).
